cards.card_text: Here's who will go: the mighty man, the warrior, the judge, the prophet, the soothsayer, the elder, the commander of fifty, the dignitary, the counselor, the cunning magician and the clever enchanter.
cards.verse_text: the mighty man and the warrior, the judge and the prophet, the soothsayer and the elder, the commander of fifty and the dignitary, the counselor, the cunning magician, and the clever enchanter.
cards.snippet: …elder, the commander of fifty and the dignitary, the counselor, the cunning magician, and the clever enchanter.

cards.card_text: Whenever the king consults them about wisdom and understanding, he stacks them up against all the magicians and enchanters in his entire kingdom.
cards.verse_text: In every matter of wisdom and understanding about which the king consulted them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his entire kingdom.
cards.snippet: …king consulted them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his entire kingdom.

cards.card_text: In every matter of wisdom and understanding, how do Daniel and his three friends measure up against all the magicians and enchanters in the king's kingdom?
cards.verse_text: In every matter of wisdom and understanding about which the king consulted them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his entire kingdom.

cards.card_text: So he summons his magicians, enchanters, sorcerers and astrologers to explain his dreams.
cards.verse_text: So the king gave orders to summon the magicians, enchanters, sorcerers, and astrologers to explain his dreams.
cards.snippet: So the king gave orders to summon the magicians, enchanters, sorcerers, and astrologers to explain his dreams.

cards.card_text: No king, however great and powerful, has ever asked anything like this of a magician, enchanter or astrologer.

cards.card_text: Before he tells the dream, what does Daniel say about the wise men, enchanters, mediums and magicians?
cards.verse_text: Daniel answered the king, “No wise man, enchanter, medium, or magician can explain to the king the mystery of which he inquires.
cards.snippet: Daniel answered the king, “No wise man, enchanter, medium, or magician can explain to the king the mystery of which he inquires.

cards.card_text: When the king tells his dream to the magicians, enchanters, astrologers and diviners, they are able to interpret it for him.
cards.verse_text: When the magicians, enchanters, astrologers, and diviners came in, I told them the dream, but they could not interpret it for me.
cards.snippet: When the magicians, enchanters, astrologers, and diviners came in, I told them the dream, but…

cards.card_text: But at last, in comes Daniel, chief of the magicians, whose name is Belteshazzar after the name of the king's god.
cards.verse_text: And I told him the dream: “O Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians, I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you and that no mystery baffles you.
cards.snippet: And I told him the dream: “O Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians, I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you…

cards.card_text: Which king made that man chief of the magicians?
cards.verse_text: Your father, King Nebuchadnezzar, appointed him chief of the magicians, enchanters, astrologers, and diviners.
cards.snippet: Your father, King Nebuchadnezzar, appointed him chief of the magicians, enchanters, astrologers, and diviners.
